REFERENCES
Image 1 is the exact start frame: keep its framing, camera, room, clothes, face and pose.

SCENE CONTEXT
Evening living room, island-axis camera: the living room on camera-left, the white marble kitchen island with an oak body, copper shelves and the fridge on camera-right; NO window in frame. Exactly as in the start image: the woman (27, Filipino-American, warm golden-tan skin, long dark wavy hair with curtain bangs, white poplin shirt with cuffed sleeves, dark-indigo jeans, small gold hoops, no glasses) alone in a chest-up close-up on the end bar stool nearest the living room, face turned up toward camera-LEFT with a small smile, copper shelves and jars behind her.

FORMAT MODE
ONE single continuous locked-off shot for the entire clip: no cuts, no shot changes, no punch-in, no second angle; the framing at the last frame is identical to the first frame.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image for the entire clip: no zoom, no pan, no dolly, no reframing, the camera never follows a person. Do not flip. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0-0.4s hold: eyes on her own phone, mouth closed. 0.4-3.4s TRIGGER+LINE: she lifts her eyes from the phone toward camera-LEFT (toward the man approaching off-frame), eyebrows up a touch, and says the line with a small conspiratorial smile, lips moving only as much as the words need. 3.4-4.0s RECOVERY: a short light laugh with the mouth almost closed, then she tilts the phone screen a few degrees toward camera-left as if to show it; holds.

CHARACTERS
Rule: the woman moves only her eyes, eyebrows and lips; head stays within a few degrees; shoulders and hands stay still except where the beats say so.

PERFORMANCE
In character: playful, conspiratorial, a little guilty-pleased; minimal facial movement. No exaggerated acting, nobody looks at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. Everyone keeps the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take; nobody else enters the frame. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The woman speaks fluent Korean with a light Filipino-English accent and a bright, playful rising rhythm: "다들 준호한테 무슨 말 할지 나한테 다 물어보고있어". Then she laughs lightly. Only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural, underplayed delivery: lips move only as much as the words need, the mouth never opens wide, no exaggerated expressions; visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word. Nobody else speaks.
